title: ‘A Woman is More Culturally Knowledgeable than A Man?’: The Effect of Personas on Cultural Norm Interpretation in LLMs
reasoning: The study focuses on the interpretation of cultural norms and social etiquette (using datasets like NORMAD and EtiCor) and evaluates sociodemographic biases (gender, race, disability, etc.). It does not benchmark religious faith, spiritual traditions, or formal moral/ethical systems.
